desc: Implement binary search on the answer $D$ from 0 to $N-1$

For each $D$, implement a feasibility check using DP: $dp[v][j]$ = minimum number of edges set to 1 in the subgraph reachable from $v$ such that every path from $v$ to $N$ has at least $j$ edges set to 1
Process vertices in reverse topological order (or use Bellman-Ford-like iterations if there are cycles)
Test the solution with the provided sample inputs.
Optimize the feasibility check if needed for larger degrees.
Handle edge cases such as multi-edges and disconnected components.
